entity_model: one persistent central entity with two user-bound conversation perspectives

ephemeral_write_policy: runtime mutation only in declared tmpfs/RAM areas such as /tmp and /run
persistent_write_policy: durable mutation only in explicitly scoped persistent data areas such as /var/lib/clayverse and separately admitted workspace volumes
machine_continuum: UnifiedDB + complete accepted EntityOS + ClayGraph + ClayVerse supervisor + Linux PTY/tmux + Claude Code + hooks/retrieval + EffectGate/EffectJournal + authenticated transport share one bounded runtime domain
ingress_policy: only explicit admitted authenticated/verified inputs cross inward; inputs are normalized, causally identified and reconciled with UnifiedDB before cognition/execution
internal_processing_loop: INGRESS -> UnifiedDB canonicalize/record -> retrieval/context -> Claude cognition -> proposed intent/command re-ingested -> policy/authority validation -> EntityOS/managed terminal execution -> stdout/stderr/result/effect receipt -> UnifiedDB causal re-entry -> repeat as needed -> EGRESS
terminal_control: accepted ClayVerse/EntityOS execution layer directly controls managed Linux PTY/tmux stdin/stdout/stderr/exit/process/filesystem operations within policy; unmediated generic host process.exec is forbidden
egress_policy: only explicit admitted outputs/effects cross outward and remain bound to canonical causal turn/effect receipts; stale/replayed/unknown/unauthorized effects fail closed
build_context: default-deny allowlist; only explicitly consumed product bytes enter OCI build context; retired headless/custom-chat runtimes and secrets are excluded
visible_surface: Browser -> Clerk -> authenticated WebSocket PTY -> user-bound persistent tmux -> normal interactive Claude Code CLI

conversation_window: newest 20 full; older stream progressively compressed to 1-2 word trace
compression_source_policy: no hidden raw source_archive after compaction; non-reversible SHA-256 receipt plus extracted durable semantic memories
memory_retrieval_organ: MicroClay: persistent bounded online-adaptive retrieval/entry-point organ inside the one ClayVerse entity; never a second state or identity authority
memory_retrieval_mode: SHADOW: deterministic query-sensitive baseline serves Claude while adaptive entry-point policy learns/scores in parallel; ACTIVE promotion requires isolated held-out/replay evidence
memory_retrieval_learning: causal/outcome-bound entry-point capital and reward EMA; verified EffectJournal outcomes are the initial automatic signal; normal Claude completion is not reward; feedback receipts are idempotent and generation-fenced
memory_retrieval_authority: accessibility/routing only; MicroClay cannot promote truth, rewrite durable memory/provenance, grant rights, change EffectGate policy or mint EntityOS authority
memory_retrieval_receipts: each canonical product retrieval binds turn_id, episode_id, causal_id, session/user, global generation, policy version/mode, query hash/token hashes, selected/shadow memory IDs, entry keys, budget and UNKNOWN/PRESENT result
memory_retrieval_current_scope: query-sensitive structured lexical baseline + learned hashed cue/kind/subject entry-point priors + causal outcome learning; full FTS/vector/ClayGraph seed activation and any neural MicroClay implementation remain open
cross_session_policy: collision-triggered only; compressed trace plus bounded extracted fragments, never wholesale other-session injection; MicroClay learning cannot broaden this boundary
hyperposition_runtime: set-valued faceted projection over bounded UnifiedDB evidence; preserves conflicting alternatives; never promotes truth or effect authority
needle_runtime: deterministic routing/pressure hint in the real hook turn path; collision/unresolved/effect-aware; never grants permissions
gwt_runtime: event-scoped workspace episode with fail-closed offered-alternative selection; no consciousness daemon
causal_identity: one predeclared causal_id per admitted user turn; verified effects re-enter through that exact identity; Stop/abort closes the same episode
snapshot_contents: consistent UnifiedDB checkpoint identity + global/session generations + EntityOS/config/policy hashes + causal queue position + EffectJournal state + managed runtime identities
recovery_tier_1: restart/fence failed internal component from immutable image bytes, reconcile last valid snapshot, re-attest readiness, resume through causal re-entry
recovery_tier_2: if invariants cannot be trusted, fail container closed and require OCI runtime/orchestrator to restart full appliance from immutable base image, recover UnifiedDB/WAL/snapshot/effect journal, mint new generation, rebuild EntityOS/terminal/Claude before reopening ingress
effect_replay_after_crash: FORBIDDEN_BY_DEFAULT; ambiguous effects become UNKNOWN_AFTER_CRASH unless explicit idempotence plus durable EffectJournal evidence proves replay safe
restart_recovery: no blind external effect replay; stale generations are fenced; interrupted turns get explicit reentry/abort; leases expire; one new global entity generation fences both sessions
runtime_readiness: read-only /readyz requires UnifiedDB schema 6, exactly two canonical users/sessions, exact tmux names, both session generations equal to global entity generation, and both canonical tmux sessions currently live and pass the managed transport-policy attestation required by attach admission
entityos_role: MANDATORY_IN_FINAL_ACCEPTED_IMAGE: complete accepted sha256-pinned internal execution/security/runtime substrate; not product endpoint
entityos_development_baseline: may be omitted only from explicitly classified development/baseline builds with execution disabled; such builds cannot receive whole-product PASS
entityos_transport: digest-bound build-time embedding plus sha256-pinned bridge; exact embedded artifact execution remains separately gated
entityos_admission: final accepted image requires verified accepted EntityOS bytes; development omission is allowed only while CLAYVERSE_ENABLE_ENTITYOS_EXEC=0 and must never be promoted as final acceptance
